name: positive-sprint-demo
query: I'm showing Danny the link-down handling tomorrow morning, 15 minutes, live on my machine
expected_behavior: Insists the demo is rehearsed end to end on the presenting machine and identifies the step most likely to fail live
Produces a one-sentence scope statement to deliver before the first click, naming what is deliberately out of scope
Predicts five likely 'can you also...' asks, each assigned to exactly one bucket (already handled / small with a named size and date / actually a new task)
Lists two or three known gaps to disclose proactively
Runs corrections-ledger check against the diff
